message.content:
A medium-sized tomato (about 123 g) contains roughly **22 calories**.  
Calories can vary slightly depending on the size and variety:

| Size | Weight (g) | Calories |
|------|------------|----------|
| Small | ~77 | ~12 |
| Medium | ~123 | ~22 |
| Large | ~182 | ~33 |

These values are averages for fresh, raw tomatoes. If you’re looking for more precise data from a specific grocery store or brand, let me know the store location and I can pull up detailed information for you.
